messages.subject: Quick poll - transformed position scales
parts:
Apart from scale_x_log10 and scale_x_reverse, does anyone use anyone
regularly use any of the transformed x and y position scales? (sqrt,
reverse, prob, asn, ...)

I'm think about removing the unusual ones to make it a little easier
to maintain, but you'll still be able to access them with
scale_x_continuous(trans = "asn") etc.
